scene: A fantastical pastel dessert-shop wonderland at dusk: towering layered cakes, macarons and glass candy jars glowing like lanterns, cream-coloured shelves and lace curtains, strings of fairy lights, sparkles in warm golden light.
far_scene: The far back of a fantastical dessert-shop wonderland at dusk: a warm glowing golden-pink sky, lace curtains, distant shelves and strings of fairy lights, soft bokeh.
